title: lobivia bridgesii subsp. yungasensis
intro: Lobivia bridgesii subsp. yungasensis, commonly known as Bolivian night-blooming cereus or Yungas lobivia, is a species of flowering plant in the cactus family (Cactaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Lobivia bridgesii subsp. yungasensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
